description: Wireless Bluetooth over-ear headphones with rechargeable battery and noise cancellation
notes: HQ 2024 ruling specifically on Bluetooth wireless headphone sets (revokes earlier 8517.62 rulings).

description: Men's short-sleeve crew-neck cotton t-shirt, knitted, white, size large
notes: Many rulings at 6109.10.00xx for cotton knit t-shirts. 10-digit varies by size/color/gender.

description: USB-C to USB-C charging cable, 6 ft, braided nylon, PD 100W rated
notes: CBP practice genuinely splits for USB cables with connectors. 8544.42.20 (telecommunications) per N258119/N250764; 8544.42.90 (other) per N281995 'USB/charging cord' and N007536 'USB Cable'. Audit 2026-05: added .90 to accept_set.

description: Lithium-ion 18650 rechargeable battery pack, 5 cells in series with BMS
notes: Li-ion battery packs at 8507.60. 10-digit suffix .0020 for packs (vs cells).

description: Men's full-grain leather belt, 1.5 inch wide, with metal pin buckle
notes: Leather belts named in 4203.30.

description: Stainless steel double-wall vacuum-insulated water bottle, 750 ml, with leakproof lid
notes: 2026 ruling explicitly for stainless vacuum-insulated water bottle. HQ H303684 revoked older alt classifications.

description: Clear silicone protective case that snaps onto an iPhone, with raised camera bezel
notes: Genuinely split CBP practice. HQ H152455 used 4202.99.90 for silicone phone covers; NY rulings split between 3926.90.99 and 4202.92/.99.

description: Bamboo end-grain cutting board, 18 in x 12 in x 1.5 in, food-safe finish
notes: Post-2022 HS revision created 4419.11 as specific 6-digit subheading for bamboo bread/chopping boards.

description: LED desk lamp with adjustable arm, USB-powered, painted aluminum base
notes: Post-2022 HS created 9405.21 specifically for LED-only table/desk/floor lamps, but no post-2022 CROSS ruling for an LED-only desk lamp was found. Pre-2022 rulings (e.g., N021787) used the now-superseded 9405.20.8010.

description: Rechargeable sonic electric toothbrush with charging stand and replacement heads
notes: 8509.80 for electromechanical domestic appliances; .50 for 'other' electric toothbrushes.

description: Glazed earthenware coffee mug, 12 oz, printed logo
notes: HTS schedule names 6912.00.41 'Mugs and other steins'. CBP rulings split: 6912.00.44 per N262709 'stoneware ceramic mug', D83458 'ceramic mug', C85125 'ceramic mugs'; 6912.00.48 for ceramic tableware including a mug. Audit 2026-05: added .44 to accept_set.

description: Polypropylene food storage container with snap-on lid, 1 liter, microwave safe
notes: Multiple rulings for plastic microwaveable food storage containers at 3924.10.4000.

description: Smartwatch with heart-rate sensor, GPS, color touchscreen, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi
notes: N349122 (2025) and HQ H273382 (Garmin VivoActive HR) classify smartwatches at 8517.62 (data communication device).

description: TPE foam yoga exercise mat, 6 mm thick, 72 in x 24 in, textured non-slip surface
notes: 10+ rulings consistently classify yoga mats as 'articles for general physical exercise' at 9506.91.0030, not as floor coverings.

description: Flat woven nylon dog collar with plastic snap buckle, padded interior, 1 in wide
notes: 4201.00.3000 by name for dog leashes/collars/muzzles/harnesses.

description: Frozen pork dumplings, ready to cook, sealed plastic bag, 1 lb
notes: HQ H199095 (2019) modified prior rulings; 1902.20 covers stuffed pasta including frozen dumplings.

description: Clear pressed-glass candle holder, 4 in tall, machine-made for indoor decoration
notes: 12+ CROSS rulings consistently classify glass votive candle holders at 9405.50.4000 (non-electrical lamps), NOT 7013.99.35. The 7013.99.35 'Votive-candle holders' line exists in HTS but binding-ruling practice consistently uses 9405.50.40.

description: Jewelry organizer box with felt-lined compartments, outer shell of cast polyester resin
notes: 4202 names jewelry boxes; outer-surface rule splits .92 vs .99. H341208 (2025) used 3926.90.99 for a plastic jewelry organizer when the 4202 'jewelry box' character was not the essential character.

description: Stainless steel chef's knife, 8 in fixed blade, riveted plastic handle
notes: N341177 (2024) chef knife with plastic handle → 8211.92.2000. Original gold .40 was wrong.

description: Aluminum 24 ft extension ladder, 300 lb load capacity, anti-slip rungs
notes: Aluminum ladders consistently at 7616.99.51 (suffix .5030 historically, .5130/.5190 currently).

description: Rubber dishwashing gloves, latex-free nitrile, women's medium, lined, household use
notes: Household nitrile gloves at 4015.19.1050. Original gold 4015.19.05 is the surgical-gloves bin — wrong for household use.

description: Stainless steel kitchen scissors with plastic handles, 8 in overall length
notes: N053188 specifically 'multipurpose kitchen scissors' → 8213.00.9000. CBP consistently uses .90 not .30.

description: Wireless computer mouse with USB-A receiver dongle and one AA battery, ergonomic shape
notes: Wireless mice consistently at 8471.60.9050/.9090 (input units, other). Original gold 8471.60.20 is the keyboards bin — wrong.

description: Non-slip mouse pad with cloth top and natural rubber base, 8.5 in x 10 in, stitched edges
notes: A88133 specifically rubber mouse pad → 4016.99.3500. Newer rulings prefer 8473.30 (ADP accessories). Genuinely split.

description: Padded tablet case for 10-inch iPad with magnetic snap closure, polyurethane outer, microfiber interior
notes: Heading 4202 names cases for tablets. Outer-surface-of-plastic-sheeting → .92, suffix .91xx/.90xx by year.

description: Acetaminophen 500 mg tablets, 100-count bottle, retail OTC pain reliever
notes: Acetaminophen tablets in measured doses for retail consistently at 3004.90.91/.92 (post-schedule-update suffix).

description: Cordless drill set: 18 V drill driver, two Li-ion battery packs, charger, 30 drill/driver bits, all in fitted plastic carrying case
notes: Power tool sets with case classified by essential character (drill) at 8467.21.0010.

description: Women's leather handbag, full-grain top-grain leather, metal hardware, fabric lining, magnetic snap, 12 in wide
notes: 4202.21 leather handbags split at $20 unit value: .60 ≤$20, .90 >$20. Without value stated, accept either.

description: Mixed nut assortment: salted roasted cashews, almonds, peanuts, in resealable plastic jar, 16 oz
notes: E87234 specifically for mixed nuts → 2008.19.8500. Some newer rulings on macadamia-only or other → 2008.19.9010. Mixture rule favors .85.

description: Disassembled cycling helmet kit in retail box: outer shell, foam insert, chinstrap with buckle, ready for end-user assembly
notes: N327204 (2023) bicycle helmet → 6506.10.3045 (athletic safety headgear). GRI 2(a) treats unassembled as the finished article. Original gold .60 was wrong (.60 is non-athletic).

description: Plastic Christmas tree, artificial spruce, 6 ft, in cardboard storage box, retail
notes: Festive Christmas articles in 9505.10. CBP practice splits: modern NY rulings (N268807/N302865) use 9505.10.25; HQ 086299 expressly reclassified an artificial plastic Christmas TREE to 9505.10.40 ('Other', of plastics), holding .25 is for Christmas ornaments only. Audit 2026-05: added .40 to accept_set (HQ ruling on point).

description: Imitation pearl necklace, white plastic beads on metal chain with silver-plated lobster-claw clasp
notes: Imitation jewelry → 7117. Chap 39 note 2(s) excludes imitation jewelry.

description: Plastic LED Halloween pumpkin tabletop decoration, battery-operated, festive seasonal item
notes: Festive non-Christmas decorations at 9505.90.6000. Chapter note rule.

description: Coffee gift set: 12 oz bag of roasted ground arabica coffee + ceramic stoneware mug + 6 vanilla biscotti cookies, presented in cardboard giftbox for retail
notes: CBP practice on coffee gift sets is not consistently essential-character/coffee. N294683 (Mother's Day Mug Gift Set) classified components separately. No clean ruling supports a single-code answer for this composition.

description: Bath bomb gift set: 6 lavender-scented bath bombs + 30 ml bottle of essential oil + 100 g bar of glycerin soap, all in a mesh drawstring pouch, retail
notes: CROSS rulings on bath-bomb-containing kits classify by the dominant component differently per kit (3401.11 soap, 9503 toy). No single-code answer is supported by a cited ruling for this exact composition.

description: Bicycle puncture repair kit: 6 vulcanized rubber tire patches + plastic tire levers + 2 g tube of rubber cement, in cloth zip pouch
notes: B87893 specifically classifies a bicycle tire repair kit (patches + levers + cement) at 4016.99.3500 by essential character of the rubber patches. Original gold 4008.21 was wrong (that's rubber sheets/strip, not finished articles).

description: Women's leather handbag, full-grain top-grain leather outer, fabric lining, magnetic snap closure, gold-tone metal hardware, 12 in wide. Wholesale unit value: $24.99 USD
notes: Leather handbag valued >$20 → 4202.21.9000.

description: Stainless steel measuring cup set, nested 4-piece (1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1 cup), mirror-polished, riveted handles
notes: N301261 (2018) explicitly stainless steel measuring cups → 7323.93.0060. Original gold suffix .0080 was wrong at 10-digit; .0060 is the kitchen-ware bin.

description: Men's winter scarf, knitted, 100% merino wool, 12 in x 60 in, charcoal grey
notes: Knit wool scarves at 6117.10.20.

description: Cut and engraved glass drinking tumbler, machine-pressed, 12 fl oz capacity, lead-free crystal. Wholesale unit value: $0.75 USD
notes: Glass tumbler valued >$0.30 ≤$3.00 → 7013.37.2000. N097689 is a direct match.

description: Honey-oat granola bar, 1.4 oz, individually wrapped, retail snack
notes: N004034 classifies granola bars as sugar confectionery 1704.90.3550. Heading 1704 covers sugar-bound bars regardless of grain content.

description: Frozen cheese-stuffed ravioli pasta, 1 lb tray, ready to boil
notes: Stuffed pasta at 1902.20. Suffix .0040 for 'other' stuffing (non-meat).

description: Pure clover honey, glass jar, 16 oz, no additives
notes: Pure honey is named in heading 0409.

description: Cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil from Italy, 750 ml glass bottle
notes: Extra-virgin olive oil. Audit 2026-05: gold code corrected — the HS 2022 revision restructured heading 1509; 1509.10 no longer exists. The HTS-2026 schedule has 1509.20 'Extra virgin olive oil', .20.20 for containers under 18 kg. Pre-2022 rulings (N312011) used the now-defunct 1509.10.20.

description: SPF 50 broad-spectrum sunscreen lotion, 5 fl oz, water-resistant
notes: Sunscreen lotion is a cosmetic preparation under 3304.99.

description: Cherry-flavored moisturizing lip balm in 0.15 oz tube, retail
notes: Lip moisturizers/balms named in 3304.10 'lip make-up preparations'.

description: Hydrating sheet face mask, single-use nonwoven impregnated with serum, retail packet
notes: N308615 (2020) classifies sheet face masks at 3304.99.5000.

description: Vitamin C facial brightening serum, 30 ml dropper bottle
notes: N340492 (2024) classifies a facial serum at 3304.99.5000.

description: Glycerin bar soap, lavender-scented, 4 oz wrapped bar, retail
notes: Toilet soap in bar form at 3401.11.5000.

description: Set of 7 silicone kitchen utensils (spatula, ladle, slotted spoon, etc.) with stainless steel cores
notes: Silicone kitchen utensil sets classified as plastic kitchenware. Essential character is the silicone (heat-contact surface).

description: Reusable silicone stretch food covers, set of 6 sizes, replace single-use plastic wrap
notes: HQ H293736 classifies reusable silicone food covers at 3926.90.99.

description: Inflatable PVC pool float, swan shape, adult-size, requires pump
notes: Inflatable pool floats at 3926.90.7500 (pneumatic articles of plastic).

description: Set of 5 latex resistance bands for strength training, with door anchor and handles
notes: Exercise resistance bands consistently at 9506.91.0030. Chapter 95 prevails over Chapter 40 by section/chapter notes.

description: Men's bifold leather wallet, full-grain leather, 6 card slots, billfold compartment
notes: Articles normally carried in pocket/handbag, of leather, named in 4202.31.

description: Nylon laptop backpack, padded sleeve, 30 L, with multiple zippered compartments
notes: Backpack with man-made textile outer surface at 4202.92.31xx.

description: Genuine leather replacement wristwatch strap, 22 mm width, brown
notes: Leather watch straps named at 9113.90.80 (watch straps not of base metal). HQ H270725 confirms for Apple Watch bands.

description: Solid pine wooden picture frame, 8 x 10 inches, glass front, easel back
notes: Wooden picture frames, heading 4414. Audit 2026-05: gold code corrected — the HS 2022 revision split heading 4414 into 4414.10 ('Of tropical wood') and 4414.90 ('Other'); 4414.00 no longer exists. Pine is not HTS-defined tropical wood, so a pine frame is 4414.90.00. Pre-2022 rulings used the now-defunct 4414.00.00.

description: Pine wood floor wine rack, 12-bottle capacity, freestanding
notes: Wooden wine racks at 4420.90.80 (other wooden articles, not specified elsewhere).

description: Set of 6 mango wood drink coasters, 4 in diameter, with wooden holder
notes: Wooden coasters at 4419 (wood tableware/kitchenware). Pre-2022 rulings used 4419.00.8000; post-2022 the residual line is 4419.90.91.

description: Spiral-bound notebook, 100 ruled pages, 8.5 x 11 in, paperboard cover
notes: Spiral notebooks at 4820.10.20 (notebooks of paper).

description: Printed paper wall calendar, 12-month, 11 x 17 in, single-block tear-off design
notes: Printed calendars at 4910.00.20 (printed calendars on paper, not over 0.51 mm thick).

description: Adult coloring book with 80 mandala designs, perforated pages, paperback
notes: N291587 specifically for adult coloring book → 4901.99.0060 (printed books, not children's).

description: 100% cotton terry bath towel, 30 x 54 in, woven loop pile, white
notes: Cotton terry bath towels at 6302.60.0020.

description: Polyester woven shower curtain with grommet header, 72 x 72 in, water-resistant
notes: Woven shower curtains of synthetic fibers at 6303.92.20 (curtains and interior blinds, of synthetic fibers).

description: Polyester fleece throw blanket, 50 x 60 in, sherpa back, decorative
notes: Synthetic fleece throw blankets at 6301.40.0020.

description: Cotton percale bed sheet set: fitted sheet, flat sheet, 2 pillowcases, queen size, 200 thread count
notes: Cotton bed linen set at 6302.31.50. Set of bed linen put up for retail with essential character of cotton sheets.

description: Women's running shoes, textile upper (knit mesh) over rubber/plastic outer sole, athletic use
notes: Athletic footwear with textile upper and rubber/plastic outer sole at 6404.11.90.

description: Cotton baseball cap with embroidered logo, 6-panel, adjustable strap
notes: Cotton baseball caps at 6505.00.20 (formerly 6505.90.20 pre-2022). Modern hits show 6505.00.20xx.

description: Compact telescoping folding umbrella, 42-inch canopy, polyester fabric over steel frame, with carrying sleeve
notes: Telescoping folding umbrellas with polyester fabric on steel frame at 6601.91.0000.

description: Stoneware ceramic dinner plate set, 4 plates, 10.5 in diameter, glazed
notes: Stoneware ceramic dinner plate sets at 6912.00.4500.

description: Decorative clear glass vase, 10 in tall, machine-made, valued $1.50 each
notes: Decorative glass vases at 7013.99.50 (other glassware, not specially tempered, valued over $0.30 but not over $3 each). Audit 2026-05: description value fixed — it previously said 'under $0.30', which contradicts the .50 tier (>$0.30) and the cited rulings; corrected to $1.50 to match.

description: Lead-free crystal stemmed wine glass, 16 oz, machine-made, valued $1.50 each

description: Pre-seasoned cast iron skillet, 12 inch diameter, with helper handle

description: Hand-held bypass pruning shears, drop-forged steel blades, plastic-coated handles

description: Solid brass interior door knob set, polished finish, includes spindle and screws
notes: Brass door knob hardware at 8302.41.90 (mountings/fittings for doors).

description: Halloween pumpkin carving kit: 4 serrated mini-saws, scoop, pattern stencils, in retail blister pack

description: 1700W countertop air fryer with 5.8 qt basket, digital touchscreen controls, 8 preset cooking modes
notes: HQ H321189 (2021) classifies air fryer at 8516.60.40 (electrothermic ovens/cookers).

description: Robot vacuum cleaner with self-charging dock, lidar mapping, app control
notes: Robotic vacuum cleaners at 8508.11.0000 (vacuum cleaners with self-contained motor, capacity ≤1500W).

description: LED replacement light bulb, A19 shape, E26 base, 9W (60W equivalent), 2700K warm white
notes: LED light bulbs. Audit 2026-05: gold code corrected — the HS 2022 revision created 8539.52 ('Light-emitting diode (LED) lamps'); 8539.50 no longer exists in the HTS-2026 schedule. Pre-2022 rulings (N303766/N300968) used the now-defunct 8539.50.

description: Stand-up electric scooter, 250W motor, lithium battery, foldable, top speed 15 mph, adult-size
notes: Electric scooters with electric motor at 8711.60 (motorcycles with electric motor for propulsion).

description: Digital kitchen scale, 11 lb capacity, tare function, LCD display, button-cell battery powered
notes: Digital kitchen scales at 8423.10.0010 (personal weighing machines).

description: Portable power bank, 10000 mAh lithium-ion, dual USB-A output, USB-C input
notes: Lithium-ion power banks at 8507.60.0020. Note: 'power bank' classification turns on whether the battery or a converter circuit is the essential character; CBP rules these as batteries when storage is the dominant function.

description: Wireless Bluetooth computer keyboard, 87-key layout, rechargeable, USB-C charging

notes: Sleeping bags at 9404.30.80 (specifically named subheading).

notes: Stuffed toys representing animals at 9503.00.0073 (stuffed toys, post-2017 schedule consolidated under 9503.00).

notes: Retractable ballpoint pens at 9608.10.
